summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc207 (100GE between S12 and S18) from about t=720 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system localized the degradation to OMS oms.S18-S17, with confidence 0.891, but did not determine a more specific cause. Coherent diagnostics completed at both ends of trx.och134. Spare-retune testing showed persistent errors at both ends of och49, och110, and och129; an earlier och49 z-end test did not complete. No site visits were made.
